title: 从路线进入名字
summary: 这座线上博物馆以长征路线为经，以人物与英烈为纬。你可以先沿全局路线前行，也可以从一个名字进入，读见一段被战火改写的人生。
summaryEn: The museum uses the Long March route as its structure and people as its living core. Visitors can begin from the full route or enter through a single name.

title: 长征星火路线交互展板
titleEn: Interactive Long March Spark Route Panel
summary: 嵌入现有 red-map 作为核心路线展板。地图节点会继续承担事件播放、会师提示和路线筛选功能。
summaryEn: The existing red-map is preserved as the core route panel, keeping event playback, convergence prompts, and route filtering.

title: 英烈画像与名录展板
summary: 以烈士姓名、所属部队、牺牲节点、资料可信度组织画像墙。没有照片的个体也以“待考证铭牌”呈现，让缺失本身成为展览内容。
summaryEn: The portrait wall is organized by name, force, sacrifice node, and source certainty. Individuals without surviving photographs are shown with research plaques so absence itself remains visible.

title: 人物生命时间线展板
summary: 每个人物页都像一份微型传记：从生平到战场，从节点到归宿。点开一个名字，就能看到他或她如何在时代激流中留下自己的坐标。
summaryEn: Each person panel combines basic biography, related events, route nodes, and source notes. Selecting a person reveals how their life connects to the map.

title: 暗线：牺牲与代价展板
summary: 路线地图告诉我们“他们走到了哪里”，暗线展板追问“他们付出了什么”：后卫牺牲、战斗损失、家属离散、雪山草地与根据地长期支撑，层层叠加成胜利背后的重量。
summaryEn: The map shows how columns arrived; the hidden-cost panel asks what sustained that arrival: covering-force sacrifice, battle losses, family separation, snow-mountain and grassland hardship, and long-running base work.

title: 战役会议与转折节点
summary: 将遵义会议、四渡赤水、强渡大渡河、会宁与将台堡会师等节点组织为路线变化的因果链。
summaryEn: This panel groups Zunyi, the Chishui maneuvers, the Dadu River crossing, Huining, and Jiangtaibao into a chain of decisions and route changes.

title: 地点与纪念设施展板
summary: 于都、遵义、泸定、吴起、会宁、将台堡等地点，不只是地理坐标，更是记忆被反复召唤的历史现场。
summaryEn: This panel connects the route, people, and memorial spaces through places such as Yudu, Zunyi, Luding, Wuqi, Huining, and Jiangtaibao.

title: 资料档案与来源审校
summary: 所有展板都保留来源 ID、资料口径和确定性字段。后续微信文章、Steam 文本和地方志材料都应先进入研究目录，再整理为候选条目。
summaryEn: Every panel keeps source IDs, certainty, and evidence notes. Future WeChat articles, Steam text, and local gazetteer materials should enter the research folder first and then become candidate entries.

title: 研究型数字策展方法
summary: 本馆采用“研究材料、策展文本、叙事结构、视觉语言、前端实现、测试复盘”的工作流，把长征路线数据转译为可浏览的展览层级。
summaryEn: The museum follows a workflow from research materials to curatorial copy, narrative structure, visual language, frontend implementation, and testing review.

title: 纪念与学习路径
summary: 观众可从“路线、英烈、人物、地点、档案”五条路径进入。纪念空间保持克制：未经核实的肖像与原文不做展示，让尊重先于渲染。
summaryEn: Visitors can learn through five paths: route, martyrs, people, places, and archives. The memorial space remains restrained and avoids publishing unverified portraits or long source text.
